title: Infinite Yous
heading: BadCode Shorts ▲ Infinite Yous

beats.name: A. The line
beats.blurb: A drunk lad at night, car keys in hand: "One version of me gets home fine."

beats.name: B. The split
beats.blurb: Multiple versions of him on the same screen, splitting off, separated by lines.

beats.name: C. Only one
beats.blurb: The BadCode balaclava figure in a science lab coat grabs the lines separating the versions and squeezes them into one, the original: "There's only one."

beats.name: D. Into the cab
beats.blurb: He kicks the lad into a cab.

beats.name: E. Headlights
beats.blurb: The BadCode logo and name; taxi headlights sweep across and light it; a cinematic car horn, not annoying.

moodboard_intro: Round 2 (Jack's notes): C. Only one redone with SP1-a's five strips and the figure as a proper scientist, no skin; D. Into the cab with that scientist. Pick one of each.
picked: C. Only one (five strips, the scientist)
D. Into the cab (the scientist, goggles up)
E. Headlights (logo on the wall in the edit)
